findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_open_position · Private data: prepare_withdraw, submit_withdraw, get_position_performance, list_rwa_pairs, get_pool_range_apr, list_positions, prepare_transaction, quote_compound, prepare_compound_transaction, quote_open_position, prepare_open_position, submit_open_position · Public sink: submit_withdraw, get_pool_range_apr, submit_signed_transaction, submit_compound_transaction, submit_open_position.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_open_position · Private data: prepare_withdraw, submit_withdraw, get_position_performance, list_rwa_pairs, get_pool_range_apr, list_positions, prepare_transaction, quote_compound, prepare_compound_transaction, quote_open_position, prepare_open_position, submit_open_position · Public sink: submit_withdraw, get_pool_range_apr, submit_signed_transaction, submit_compound_transaction, submit_open_position

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
